script.spoken: United Airlines Flight 232 lost all flight controls. The tail engine exploded, and debris cut all three hydraulic systems. The crew steered using only the engine throttles. The cause was a hidden flaw inside a titanium fan disk. A crack grew from it for years. The backups failed because their lines ran side by side. The crash landing still left most people alive. Engine disks are now inspected far more strictly.
